name: Apprenticeship — Legacy Completed (AY 25/26), Same Course POST Next AY (26/27)
description: Provider A's apprenticeship (standard 21) is a 'legacy' record: created directly by Commitments' ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, never a draft. Provider A then completes it via PUT, entirely within AY 25/26 (start 2026-04-01, completion 2026-06-01) — via the legacy PUT route (/providers/{ukprn}/learning/{learnerKey}), no academicYear param needed since it's still AY 25/26. Provider A then POSTs a new draft for the SAME learner and SAME course (standard 21), this time starting in AY 26/27 (2026-08-01) — a same-provider, same-course repeat of a completed apprenticeship in the following academic year, via the new-style route (/providers/{ukprn}/apprenticeships?academicYear=2627) rather than the legacy /learners route, since this POST is for the next academic year. Exploratory: CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle calls ApprenticeshipLearningRepository.GetByLearnerKey unconditionally, unscoped by course code or UKPRN (unlike short courses' provider/course-scoped lookup) — with the completed standard-21 row as the only existing ApprenticeshipLearning row at POST time, it's not confirmed whether the handler correctly creates a new row for the new AY or mistakenly matches/reuses the completed row since the course code is identical. This story captures actual current behaviour rather than asserting a known-correct contract.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship (Provider A, Standard 21, Never a Draft, AY 25/26)
SLD (Provider A) Records Completion, Standard 21, Within AY 25/26
SLD (Provider A) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship, Same Standard 21, AY 26/27

assertions.name: Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner (completed AY 25/26, new draft AY 26/27)
